source.title: TNoodle 1.1.0 release
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-1.1.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

Main visible changes that have been made since TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1:

* Fixed bug that triggered scrambles when opening translations
* Fixed bug that would print deselected FMC translations
* Add progress bar to each event
* Fixed bug that could occur while generating PDFs with non ASCII characters
* Fixed bug affecting TNoodle releases (this bug was responsible for we having no week phase out this time; delegates responsible for the nearest competitions were told about this in advance)
* Logout after token expiration
* Freeze human interaction while generating scrambles (first contribution by [shzcuber](https://github.com/shzcuber))
* Add collapsing sidebar (first contribution by [JonEsparaz](https://github.com/JonEsparaz))
* Skip ordered scrambles if schedule is broken instead of failing the whole process
* Fix spaces in some messages
* Generate only 1 empty sheet for competitions with FMC (as opposed to 1 per round, which was redundant)
* Fix (unreported bug) that would translate incorrectly FMC sheets for some Asian languages

A complete list of all changes can be found [here](https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0).

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

translation.title: TNoodle 1.1.0 发布
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-1.1.0 现已发布，可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。

相较于 TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1，主要可见改动如下：

* 修复打开翻译时会触发打乱生成的问题
* 修复最少步翻译取消选择后仍会打印的问题
* 为各项目增加进度条
* 修复生成包含非 ASCII 字符的 PDF 时可能出现的问题
* 修复影响 TNoodle 发布的问题（因此本次没有一周的过渡期；近期比赛的负责代表已提前收到通知）
* 令牌过期后退出登录
* 生成打乱期间禁用用户操作（[shzcuber](https://github.com/shzcuber) 的首次贡献）
* 增加可折叠侧栏（[JonEsparaz](https://github.com/JonEsparaz) 的首次贡献）
* 赛程有误时跳过按顺序整理的打乱，而不是让整个流程失败
* 修正部分提示中的空格
* 含最少步项目的比赛只生成 1 张空白纸，而不是每轮生成 1 张，避免重复
* 修复部分亚洲语言的最少步纸张翻译错误（此前未被报告的问题）

完整改动列表见[此处](https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0)。

请注意，正式比赛必须使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。
